Definition: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun πός (some) otherwise obsolete (compare G4214); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly:--about, a certain place.
BiblicalUsage: Pou means somewhere, about, nearly, in a certain place. The writer to the Hebrews says one in a certain place testified, and Luke says the sailors feared falling upon rocks somewhere off the shore.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe somewhere is enough for faith, because God knows the place even when I only know it is somewhere.
